decision.reason: The newest integrated rehearsal has no event projection, while the projected copy contains only unreviewed candidate events with unknown knowledge status.
required_before_enablement: Select one integrated rehearsal database containing the current document/topic schema and event projection.
Define an event publication/admission state that is distinct from candidate clustering.
Require explicit candidate labeling and prevent unknown candidates from appearing as confirmed events.
Validate entity/topic references, version hashes, evidence pairs, and current-version chains.
Run fixed event quality sampling before enabling downstream macro or sentiment consumers.

limitations: Both inputs are isolated Mac copies, not a fresh Windows production export.
This audit measures structural readiness, not event clustering accuracy.
